title: Synthesis and Binding Profile Using Molecular Dynamics of New Building Blocks for PSMA Theranostics and the PSMA617-Cystine-Doxorubicin Therapeutic Bioconjugate Against Prostate Cancer
authors: Evangelos Machairas; George Laros; George Lambrinidis; Maria Halabalaki; Christos Liolios; Antonios Kolocouris
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究PSMA（GCPII）配体及生物偶联物的结合特征，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作建模，但对象为酶-配体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: GCPII also known as Prostate Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA), is overexpressed in prostate cancer (PCa) cells and provide a biomarker for tumor targeting PSMA receptor. The development of lysine-urea-glutamate pharmacophore based inhibitors targeting PSMA for theranostics applications led to PSMA11 and PSMA617. In PSMA11, this pharmacophore is attached via aminohexanoic acid (Ahx) spacer to a chelator while in PSMA617 the pharmacophore is connecting with the linker 2-naphthyl-L-Ala, trans-4-(aminomethyl)cyclohexanecarboxylic acid and then to chelator. Here, we synthesized: (a) a squaramide analog of lysine-urea-glutamic acid; (b) two new building blocks for PSMA theranostics in which lysine-urea-glutamic acid was attached with two (i) phenyl alanine residues to target arene binding site of PSMA receptor and (ii) amino hexanoic acid residues. (d) Inspired from the promising structure of PSMA617 we synthesized a new bioconjugate prodrug in which we replaced the chelator in PSMA617 with a cleavable cystine linker attached to the anticancer drug Doxorubicin. Induced fit docking and MD simulations explored the binding profile of the new molecules.
abstract_zh: GCPII，也称为前列腺特异性膜抗原（PSMA），在前列腺癌（PCa）细胞中过表达，并为靶向PSMA受体的肿瘤靶向提供生物标志物。基于赖氨酸-尿素-谷氨酸药效团的PSMA抑制剂开发，用于诊疗一体化应用，催生了PSMA11和PSMA617。在PSMA11中，该药效团通过氨基己酸（Ahx）间隔臂连接到螯合剂，而在PSMA617中，药效团通过连接子2-萘基-L-丙氨酸、反式-4-(氨甲基)环己烷羧酸连接到螯合剂。在此，我们合成了：(a) 一种赖氨酸-尿素-谷氨酸的方酰胺类似物；(b) 两个用于PSMA诊疗一体化的新构建模块，其中赖氨酸-尿素-谷氨酸分别与两个(i)苯丙氨酸残基（以靶向PSMA受体的芳烃结合位点）和(ii)氨基己酸残基相连。(d) 受PSMA617有前景结构的启发，我们合成了一种新的生物偶联前药，其中将PSMA617中的螯合剂替换为可裂解的半胱氨酸连接子，并连接到抗癌药物多柔比星。诱导拟合对接和分子动力学（MD）模拟探索了新分子的结合特性。
